edits.after: Your Q outranges his hook early; dodge Death Sentence and it stays an even poke war.

edits.after: The poke war stays even while his hook's down — punish the miss.

edits.after: Range keeps it close, but one landed hook flips it his way.

edits.before: Chip the ledger and bank the souls — the collection out-scales every support item.
edits.after: His hook into Flay and lantern utility start winning picks against your poke.

edits.before: - Thresh Death Sentence: matchup-defining — The hook starts the lantern chain — dodge it and the playbook waits 19 seconds. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep E Curse of the Black Mist banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Thresh's Q Death Sentence starts the chain — dodge it and he waits 19s at rank 1. - His W Dark Passage shields whoever he casts it on — force it out before your burst, or the shield eats it. - Bank E for his lantern engage, not chip trades.
